text:
nora: Planning Lyric Systems private cutover Friday 2026-04-02 23:00 UTC (03:00 local for their infra). This is Dedicated -> Private tenant move. Need quick checks: KMS rotation collision, runtime/model pin, maintenance window OK, and final rollback play.

deploybot: new schedule created • id=rb-9221 • when=2026-04-02T23:00:00Z • target=tenant/lyric/private
`deploybot: /deploy schedule --id rb-9221 --slice lyric --env private --when 2026-04-02T23:00Z`

chao: +1 to the time. Please pin runtime to v1.11.9 (we haven't fully validated v1.12.x on their long-horizon prompts) and model to redwood-4-quant-v2. Also set `MAX_BATCH_LATENCY=20ms` for this tenant.

ops-ryan: Maintenance window request: 2.5h (23:00-01:30 UTC) to allow extra warm-up. Confirmed network owners for their VPC CIDR (10.20.0.0/16) are aware. KMS note: Lyric has scheduled key rotation at 2026-04-02T23:15Z by their infra team 99. Need exception or we'll collide.

vela: We should ask Lyric to postpone rotation by 90 minutes. I can send the customer note if ops-ryan confirms the exact key id.

nora: KMS key id is kms-lyric-02-prod. Ops-ryan can you confirm we can get an exception? If not, we need to shift start to 01:00 UTC.

ops-ryan: I requested the exception from their infra. If they deny, shift is required. Marking tentative.

samir: Rollback policy proposed: immediate rollback if 5xx error rate >2% for 3 consecutive mins OR token-level misgen rate (detected by eval hooks) >4% for 10m. Also manual rollback if p95 latency >2000ms for 5m. Rollback script placed: `s3://redwood-releases/rollback/lyric/rb-9221.sh`.

chao: Canary plan: 3% for 8m -> 20% for 12m -> 100% ramp. Metrics to watch: 5xx, p95 latency, GPU mem, KV cache hit%. Add golden prompt diff checks.

deploybot: update: rb-9221 pinned runtime=v1.11.9 model=redwood-4-quant-v2 envflags=`--max-batch-latency=20ms --kv-cache=3G`

vela: Drafted release note blurb: "Model quantization update to redwood-4-quant-v2 for Lyric. Minor inference latency decrease expected; see risks about edge-case hallucination rates." Customer notification ready at https://internal.docs/rls/lyric-04-02 (WIP).

ops-ryan: Runbook: `sops/rollouts/lyric/rb-9221-runbook.md` includes smoke tests: 1) health-check x12, 2) 200 short inference calls, 3) KV cache priming, 4) endpoint auth check. Need two approvals (SRE + SE) before 100% shift.

chao: I can be SE ack. SRE please? @samir can you or ops-ryan ack SRE side?

samir: I'll take SRE ack during window but can prelim ack now: :white_check_mark: prechecks look good. But we need Lyric KMS exception confirmed before final.

vela: Sent customer note asking to postpone key rotation. Pinged their infra lead.

nora: Ops-ryan, if customer refuses delay, propose new window 2026-04-03T01:00Z. Please confirm earliest we can shift without impacting other scheduled tenants.

ops-ryan: We have a hard slot at 02:00Z for another tenant. Moving to 01:00Z is possible but will reduce warm-up to 60m. I'm OK with that if Lyric insists.

deploybot: NOTE: rb-9221 has canary policy applied and rollback hook configured. notify-on-fail=oncall@redwood.internal

vela: Customer replied: they can delay rotation by 2 hours. Exception granted.

chao: Great. With KMS cleared, SE ack: :thumbsup:. I approve runtime/model pins and flags.

samir: Final SRE ack: :thumbsup: I'll join war-room channel. Ops-ryan confirmed permissions on rollback script and runbook.

nora: All right team, final confirms: 1) KMS no-collision 2) runtime v1.11.9 pinned 3) model redwood-4-quant-v2 pinned 4) canary policy/rollback thresholds in place 5) runbook has smoke tests and perms. If everyone thumbs-up I'll mark go for scheduled window.

ops-ryan: :white_check_mark:

chao: :thumbsup:

vela: :thumbsup: customer notif sent.

nora: Approved. Scheduling is locked. I'll open the war-room 30m before start. Thanks.
